channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about OG Anunoby | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about OG Anunoby from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast. And so when you add all these personalities to a team, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, you know, Bron, VJ Edgecombe, you know, Jaylen Brown, you need a coach that can handle all that that's going to put them in the right situation. A lot of them, everyone's going to talk about usage rate, but Nick Nurse made it work in Toronto with, you know, OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam, Kyle Lowry and Kawhi Leonard.”

Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Paul Pierce on OG Anunoby
item.description:
NBA Courtside:Paul Pierce on if OG Anunoby should be finals MVP:

“I’m not giving OG Anunoby no goddamn flowers. I’m giving him the Finals MVP.TAKE THAT HOME, OG. I’m telling you, take home the finals MVP. He’s been dominant…. He’s been the most dominant player in this finals. Quite as is kept now after four games. When you look at the numbers and add them up.”

Paul Pierce on OG Anunoby, Jun 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Spurs’ De’Aaron Fox on attempting the layup late rather than running the clock:

“I just thought I’d be able to outrun [Knicks’ OG Anunoby]. That’s it.”

De'Aaron Fox on OG Anunoby, Jun 11, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Mike Brown on OG Anunoby against the Spurs, thus far:

“He's getting better as the series has gone along. He's been great for us in the playoffs so far. I think he can reach an even higher plateau”

Mike Brown on OG Anunoby, Jun 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on OG Anunoby
item.description:
If Brunson is Captain Clutch, it has become clear that Anunoby is his partner in crime.

“Our defensive player of the game, just put his footprint on both ends, another All-Star is OG Anunoby,”

Mike Brown on OG Anunoby, Dec 30, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mike Brown on Tim Duncan, Bruce Bowen, OG Anunoby
item.description:
Ian Begley:Mike Brown on OG Anunoby as a defender:

“First-team All Defense. He is more than capable. Really it’s up to him. That’s how good he is on that end of the floor. And I’ve been around those guys; Bruce Bowen, Tim Duncan. I’ve been around a few of them and he’s right there.”

Mike Brown on Tim Duncan, Bruce Bowen, OG Anunoby, Sep 26, 2025. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on whether or not OG Anunoby looks like his old self again:

“Yeah I think the break was good for him; we’ll see how he responds tomorrow after (going through) practice today.”

Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby, Feb 19, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Leon Rose on OG Anunoby
item.description:
NYK's Leon Rose on re-signing of OG Anunoby:

“Since his arrival in New York, OG has personified the type of player this organization & city embody... Weare thrilled to bring OG back to New York & continue the process of building a team & culture that makes our fans proud.”

Leon Rose on OG Anunoby, Jul 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Ryan Dunn on Paul George, OG Anunoby, Herb Jones
item.description:
Ryan Dunn:

“There are a lot of players I watch like Paul George and Herb Jones too defensively. I think the closest I probably have is OG Anunoby right now with him in the playoffs with his size and strength defensively.”

Ryan Dunn on Paul George, OG Anunoby, Herb Jones, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Josh Hart on Joel Embiid, OG Anunoby
item.description:
Ian Begley:Josh Hart on OG Anunoby & Precious Achuiwa defense on Joel Embiid:

“I don’t think you can give them enough credit, honestly. They played tough. OG was like, 'I want that match up' And he did a good job on him & then when we switched & Precious got on him, he did a great job.”

Josh Hart on Joel Embiid, OG Anunoby, Apr 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Fred Katz:Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby limping a bit at the end of the game:

“Everyone has a little limp. If you're playing hard, you got something. I mean, Jesus.”

Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby, Apr 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Cam Thomas on OG Anunoby, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Erik Slater:Cam Thomas on his Jalen Brunson foul and OG Anunoby altercation at the end of the game:

“He just over exaggerated and flopped… So kudos to him for that…He got a tech on me though, I don’t like that.”

Cam Thomas on OG Anunoby, Jalen Brunson, Apr 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Thibodeau on if Anunoby came back too early:

“You can’t work backwards. There’s many steps he had to go through. He met all the markers. He was cleared. This is a possibility. Whenever you come back from surgery, this is what you’re looking at... We feel good about where he is.”

Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby, Mar 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby, who has missed four games due to right elbow inflammation:

“You’ve always gotta trust the medical (staff) and trust the player. So when he’s healthy enough, and he feels comfortable and he can trust his body, he’ll be out there.”

Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby, Feb 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Kawhi Leonard, OG Anunoby
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on OG Anunoby:

“There’s certain guys you don’t want to bring into the mix. In the West, when we play LAC, we want to keep Kawhi Leonard away from the ball because he just is so positively impactful for them and negative for us. OG has a lot of similarities.”

Rick Carlisle on Kawhi Leonard, OG Anunoby, Feb 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby playing 86 total min in back-to-back:

“Right now, we’ve got to find our way as we’re adjusting. So, find a way to win & then build ourrhythm…Just go day by day & some guys are playing big minutes (because) we’re shorthanded.”

Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby, Jan 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby
item.description:
Ujiri on the decision to pivot, trade Anunoby/Siakam and go younger:

“The uncertainty of free agency was a big factor. We also looked at the trend of the team. We tried to give it as much time as we can.”

Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Jan 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Fred Katz:Jalen Brunson on what makes OG Anunoby a great defender:

“I don’t know. The dude’s just a freak of nature. I’m watching the same thing you guys are watching. Just like, “Oh, wow! Mmm. OK.’”

Jalen Brunson on OG Anunoby, Jan 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on the Anunoby addition:

“We feel like we're scoring plenty, but we have to shore up our defense.”

Tom Thibodeau on OG Anunoby, Jan 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on OG Anunoby
item.description:
DeRozan on his former teammate O.G. Anunoby & his growth as a defender:

“Its incredible. His anticipation, his strength, his movement, his athleticism... That makes him an elite perimeter defender in this league. It definitely started from me kicking his ass in practiceeveryday”

DeMar DeRozan on OG Anunoby, Apr 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Nick Nurse on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nick Nurse on O.G. Anunoby's case for NBA All-D:

“I'm not sure who's as versatile, period. And who's as effective, even on the winning teams. He's certainly an all-defensive team player in my mind, for sure, if not the winner of the [DPOY] award.”

Nick Nurse on OG Anunoby, Mar 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Lowry on Anunoby:

“I think OG’s always been a great defender. He’s been one of the best defenders in the league since he’s been in the league. Now, I just think he’s taking more pride in doing it because he’s getting the attention, which he should have been getting (before).”

Kyle Lowry on OG Anunoby, Nov 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Bobby Webster on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Vivek Jacob:Bobby Webster on OG Anunoby rumours:

“We have great communication with OG...it doesn't make sense to talk about trade speculation, I don't think it's all that noteworthy.”

Bobby Webster on OG Anunoby, Jun 21, 2022. Source: Twitter @vivekmjacob.

item.title: Fred VanVleet on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:VanVleet on Anunoby:

“OG is a huge part of what we do here... He's a key foundation of our team on both sides of the ball. And he's just a really, really good NBA player, there's no secret to that, so having him out there definitely helps our team.”

Fred VanVleet on OG Anunoby, Mar 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby
item.description:
Nurse on Siakam/Anunoby/Barnes trio:

“Those 3 guys are going to be the mainstays in the middle of our rotation and take as many minutes as they can handle... We're trying to develop 3 really good 2-way players there that are versatile.”

Nick Nurse on Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Nov 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Malachi Flynn, Scottie Barnes, Dalano Banton
item.description:
“There are going to be growing pains, trust me, you know like, sometimes it's gonna be tough to watch but we know what's coming,we know we're excited about the young talent. They are excited to play - to see how, OG [Anunoby], Pascal [Siakam], Fred, are going to evolve as leaders - as elite players. And then the young guys, [Scottie] Barnes, Malachi [Flynn], Dalano [Banton]. In sports, people think 'now,' you know? And this is where we have to be patient and let it grow.”

Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Malachi Flynn, Scottie Barnes, Dalano Banton, Sep 9, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Nick Nurse on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nurse on OG Anunoby:

“He's super hungry, he's super motivated to be a really good player at both ends of the floor. He's working, he's studying, his conditioning is amazing, his care for his body is amazing. He wants it really badly.”

Nick Nurse on OG Anunoby, Apr 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Dwane Casey on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Dwane Casey on OG Anunoby:

“He's such a beautiful young man. You have to get to know him,he's quiet and doesn't allow you in unless he wants to, but under that he's a beautiful kid and his spirit is always good for your team.”

Dwane Casey on OG Anunoby, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Eric Walden:Rudy Gobert:

“(OG Anunoby) tried to elbow me in the face. And the guy who’s getting paid to protect the players didn’t do his job. We both got ejected when I didn’t do anything back, which I don’t understand. Next time I’ll do justice myself so (they) can eject me for a reason.”

Rudy Gobert on OG Anunoby, Mar 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Nick Nurse on OG Anunoby
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nurse on OG Anunoby, who's making his preseason debut tonight:

“I'm not sure he was ever 100% physically last year... He's noticeably improved from last year. So let's hope we notice that, not necessarily tonight, but pretty quickly.”

Nick Nurse on OG Anunoby, Oct 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.
